blocks.html:
Chrome Delete For Mercedes C300

Chrome Delete, in general, is something that most people won’t care about. However, when you are passionate about turning a car into your dream car, getting rid of those silver stripes usually takes a spot on your to-do list. It was a similar case for one of our clients, Mr. Nataniel.

He wanted to get rid of what he considered annoying i.e the silver chrome stripes because they came in the way of him having his car his way. He believed the silver didn’t complement his Mercedes C300’s full black beauty. So he decided to have them deleted (covered) with a colour that he believes goes with the colour of his car. The colour our client picked was “Gloss Black” from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series to match the gloss black paint job.

Having received a lot of requests for chrome deletes, we can say that most of our customers go with “Gloss Black”.

Deleting chromes from the Mercedes C300 wasn’t a big deal for our experienced installers since they’ve been wrapping far larger vehicles and objects for more than a decade. It was quick for our team and the client got to drive home in his Mercedes C300 the same day. We’ve attached some of the Mercedes C300 on this page after the Chrome delete process.

Nathaniel chose gloss black to cover the chrome on his Mercedes C300. Is that the only option you have? Certainly Not. Experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto came forth to make you aware of your options while getting Chrome deleted. Let’s jump in:

  • Pick Any Colour: It doesn’t always have to be black. In fact, you can get any colour you wish from the colour spectrum. However, the reason why people get the chromes deleted is that they believe the silver is not going with the colour of the rest of the car. So what you decide to get to make your car more appealing, depends largely on the colour of your vehicle. In this case, our client wanted to go with the same colour and finish as the rest of his Mercedes C300.
  • Quick & Easy: Chrome Delete jobs is a quick option and can be done in a matter of a few hours as long as you know what you want and the material is available at the garage. When we say it’s quick and easy, we mean by professionals. For someone who hasn’t done it before it could result in a disaster. But rest assured you can drive your car back home with the chromes deleted within a few hours.
  • Explore different finish options: When you do wish to get a Chrome delete job, don’t forget to go through the different finishes available. The finish of the material can make your car look way better. Available finishes include Gloss, Matte, and Satin.
  • Tap into your pool of creativity: if you wish to go wild with your imagination, there is something you can do that people don’t generally go for when they get a Chrome delete job. It is to get a custom-printed pattern on the material. Yes, anything is possible at Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our showroom at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts. Check out more car wraps here.
